artifact_body_text.input: Held UTF-8 artifact bytes; emitted evidence body component.

canonical_record_units.input: Actual search/source records and held response bytes before the result packet builder; current account-record-unit rule is checked.

correction_history_component.input: Synthetic immutable retained-history records, delivered by review_protocol.deliver_review and serialized before the actual frozen_reassessment_packet reader. The correction builder copies historical_reviews verbatim; this component factory does not claim correction eligibility, whole-request admission or 10,000 observed model calls.

correction_reference_records.input: Real held synthetic problem-value and account records, actual acquired/full-read source bytes, prospective repair assignment, two authenticated instrumented native refusals, then the actual eligible correction builder. Synthetic provider probe observations supply construction room; the separately keyed stage1 allowance sizes the upstream stress input, not a claim that this complete correction is admitted there.

family_reading_plans.input: Scale bound found work ids upstream of list_reading_texts and emit each physical plan position.

staged_adjudicator_original_text.input: Frozen focused-adjudicator epoch and upstream scientific record text.

staged_original_text.input: Frozen epoch manifest from an upstream scientific record with scaled text.

v6_reading_records.input: The real v6 manifest, exact search receipts or synthetic upstream turn-receipt rows, serialized by _assemble_reading_turn. A scaled turn list is builder/shape evidence, not 10,000 observed calls or a claim of whole-request admission.
